basic_info.description: Tucked away atop a boutique Pacific Heights building, this expansive top-floor residence offers a rare sense of seclusion and opportunity. Direct elevator access opens to a formal entry with newly installed hardwood floors, leading to a generously sized living and dining area designed for effortless entertaining. The thoughtful floor plan balances open gathering spaces with private retreats, including a serene primary suite featuring a separate den and a spa-like bath with a soaking tub. A distinct bedroom wing includes two additional bedrooms with easy access to two full baths, plus a front bedroom that doubles perfectly as an office or guest space. Multiple outdoor spaces highlighted by an exclusive-use roof deck offer private, sunlit retreats with iconic city views. Independent two-car garage parking and a secure building add convenience and peace of mind. With incredible bones and endless potential, this is a home ready to be tailored to your vision. Situated in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, the home is just one block from Lafayette Park.
